observation: The pull-request self-shape job executes repository code while inheriting default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions, and actions/checkout persisted its credential into the workspace. An independent review flagged both excessive permissions and credential persistence.

evidence.summary: The review reported excessive-permissions and artipacked warnings for self-shape-dogfood and recommended job-level contents: read plus checkout persist-credentials: false.

evidence.command: pending: merge-candidate CI after token hardening
evidence.summary: Validation is pending. Promote only if the self-shape job retains full checkout/history behavior and the complete CI matrix remains green with read-only token permissions and no persisted checkout credential.

hypothesis: A pull-request dogfood job that only reads repository contents should declare least-privilege token permissions and should not leave checkout credentials available to the PR-controlled workspace.
